name: fiefdom
description: An isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. Build a settlement in the desert, run the food, ale and weapon chains, raise a garrison and hold your ground against an enemy lord who builds his own economy under the same rules you do. ⚙ Nothing to configure: no database, no API keys, no accounts. Set the port, keep the Saves path on appdata, start it, open the WebUI. 💾 Saved games and custom maps are stored on the server under /data — map it to appdata and they survive updates and are the same in every browser. (Leave it unmapped and the game falls back to per-browser storage.) Runs entirely client-side: the container only serves static files and a few kilobytes of saves, so it uses almost no CPU or memory on the server. A WebGL-capable browser is required.

paths.name: Saves
paths.description: Where saved games and custom maps are kept. Leave on appdata so they survive container updates.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the game is reached on.

variables.name: Cloudflare Access team
variables.description: OPTIONAL. To give each player their own separate saves via a login, put your Cloudflare Zero Trust team name here (the part before .cloudflareaccess.com). Requires a Cloudflare Access application in front of this hostname. Leave blank for a single shared profile.

variables.name: Cloudflare Access AUD
variables.description: OPTIONAL, used with the team name above. The Application Audience (AUD) tag of your Cloudflare Access application, which ties tokens to THIS app. Find it in Zero Trust > Access > Applications > your app > Overview.
